Turn a public webpage, transcript or recording into a speaking script

YouTube の文字起こしを貼り付け, import TXT, Markdown, SRT or VTT subtitles, or read a public webpage that allows browser access. Remove timestamps and filler formatting, then shape the result into an editable script.

Keep control of your source material

Text cleanup and OCR happen in this browser. Audio and video transcription is 任意: you choose the provider, file and API key, then receive precise SRT captions when that provider returns timestamps.
